title.zh: 多点联动锁（uPVC / 复合门）

summary.en: One cylinder and one handle drive hooks and rollers at three or more points along the door edge through a gearbox. The handle must be lifted to throw the bolts, which is the fact that breaks most naive retrofit motors.
summary.zh: 一个锁芯与一个把手通过齿轮箱带动门边上三处或更多的钩与滚轮。把手必须上抬才能上锁——这一点会让大多数简单的改造电机失效。

en: Gearbox (centre case) holding the cylinder and spindle
Extension strips above and below carrying hooks or rollers
Oval or euro cylinder depending on door age
zh: 齿轮箱（中央锁体），容纳锁芯与方轴
上下延伸条，承载钩或滚轮
视门的年代使用椭圆或欧标锁芯

measurements.typical: 92 mm most common; 85 mm and 72 mm also exist

how.en: Spindle centre to cylinder centre on the gearbox face.
how.zh: 在齿轮箱端面上量方轴中心到锁芯中心。

how.en: Top screw hole to bottom screw hole.
Measure the strip width on the door edge.

measurements.typical: Oval cylinders 62–92 mm total; euro profile on newer doors in 5 mm steps

how.en: Remove the central screw, take the cylinder out and measure both halves.
how.zh: 拆下中央螺钉取出锁芯，分别量两段。

notes.en: The motor must rotate the cylinder enough to retract the hooks AND the user must still lift the handle. Designs that ignore the lift step produce a lock that appears to work in the lab and fails on every real door.
notes.zh: 电机必须把锁芯转到足以收回钩舌，而用户仍需上抬把手。忽略上抬这一步的设计，会在实验室里看似成功，却在每一扇真实门上失败。

en.q: How do I find the centre distance without removing the handle?
en.a: Look at the gearbox face through the handle opening, or measure from the spindle centre to the cylinder centre with the handle off — usually 92 mm on a British door.

en.q: Is the gearbox replaceable on its own?
en.a: Yes, and it is the part that fails first. Match centre distance, backset, strip width and the number of locking points.

zh.q: 不拆把手怎么知道中心距？
zh.a: 从把手开口看齿轮箱端面，或拆下把手后量方轴中心到锁芯中心——英式门通常是 92 mm。
可以，而且它是最先坏的部件。要匹配中心距、背距、延伸条宽度与锁点数量。
